I will keep this plot cheap because it is very small, and I cannot risk much cash on fertilizer for just 0.05 hectares. I will use manure or compost from home, plant the maize with the intercrop the way I usually do, and stay with seed I know unless I get a small pack cheaply. I do not spray chemicals on food crops here, and I will depend on the rains, then use my own labor with family help for weeding and harvesting.
